'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]], [[Russia–NATO relations]], [[Ukraine–NATO relations]]
***[[Sweden]] announces a package of $1.23 billion in military aid to [[Ukraine]], the largest given by Sweden so far. [https://apnews.com/article/sweden-ukraine-military-aid-bd1001a45e7fff44cf4c766b84e76ace (AP)]
***[[France]] and [[Germany]] announce that French and German weapons sent to Ukraine, including long-range missiles, are permitted to target bases inside Russia. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/05/28/europe/ukraine-french-weapons-russia-macron-intl-hnk-ml/index.html (CNN)]
***The [[Ministry of National Defence (Poland)|Polish Defence Ministry]] says it has given [[Ukraine]] permission to use Polish-supplied weapons to strike targets inside Russian territory. **[[Rafah offensive]]
***[[Israel]] says that it has taken full control of the [[Egypt–Gaza border]] after capturing the [[Philadelphi Corridor]]. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023–2024 Sundhnúkur eruptions]]
**The town of [[Grindavík]], [[Iceland]], and the nearby [[Blue Lagoon (geothermal spa)|Blue Lagoon]] are evacuated due to [[2023–2024 Sundhnúkur eruptions|volcanic activity]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c844em2ey7eo (BBC News)] 
*At least 28 people are killed when a bus falls into a ravine in [[Washuk District]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/29/at-least-28-killed-after-bus-falls-into-ravine-in-pakistans-balochistan (Al Jazeera)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Brazil–Israel relations]]
**[[Brazil]] recalls its [[ambassador]] to Israel amid an ongoing diplomatic crisis between the two countries. [https://www.reuters.com/world/lula-removes-brazilian-ambassador-israel-amid-diplomatic-spat-2024-05-29/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Amnesty International]] says that the number of [[Capital punishment|executions]] recorded globally in 2023 was the highest since 2015 and up more than 30% from 2022, with [[Capital punishment in Iran|Iran]] carrying out 74% of the global total. The figures exclude [[China]], because execution numbers are considered a state secret. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c1rr0178rzeo (BBC News)]
*Four people are injured in a [[mass shooting]] in [[Dalston]], [[London]], UK. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cv22pg27lg5o (BBC News)]
